notes: CamelCase headers as in the MarineCadastre product, plus the transponder's Destination field. BaseDateTime is UTC ISO 8601 without a zone suffix. SOG in knots, COG/Heading in degrees true. One row per received position report; static fields are repeated on every row as broadcast.
entity_catalog: registries/vessels.json (130 vessels) and registries/terminal_registry.json (45 berths, 77 slips, 30 anchorage positions)

fields.name: MMSI
fields.notes: 9-digit MMSI as broadcast; the first three digits are the flag's maritime identification digits. Joins vessels.json mmsi. Hulls with no transponder (vessels.json transceiver_class null) never appear.

fields.name: Heading
fields.notes: True heading 0-359; 511 = not available (common on Class B units)

fields.name: VesselName
fields.notes: Uppercase, max 20 chars; vessels.json vessel_name without the MT/MV/FV prefix

fields.name: IMO
fields.notes: Prefix 'IMO' + 7 digits with a valid check digit; blank if not assigned

fields.name: VesselType
fields.notes: vessels.json ais_type_code: 80/84 tanker and LNG, 70/79 cargo and supply, 30 fishing, 31 towing, 33 dredging, 35 military, 36 sailing, 37 pleasure, 50 pilot, 51 rescue, 52 tug, 53 tender, 54 anti-pollution, 55 law enforcement, 60 passenger and ferry, 90 other

fields.name: Status
fields.notes: 0=under way using engine, 1=at anchor, 3=restricted manoeuvrability, 5=moored, 7=engaged in fishing, 15=not defined (all Class B units)

fields.name: Cargo
fields.notes: Cargo type code per ITU-R M.1371 Table 18

fields.name: TransceiverClass
fields.notes: A=Class A (SOLAS), B=Class B; vessels.json transceiver_class

fields.name: Destination
fields.notes: Free text typed into the transponder (max 20 characters): usually a UN/LOCODE or port name. Blank for Class B.

registry.vessel_id_format: VSL-nnnn (barges BRG-nnnn); vessels are joined to AIS by MMSI

files.ais_YYYY-MM.csv: Shore-station feed, one file per calendar month (2027-08 to 2028-01). Reception to about 45 nm offshore.
files.satellite/sais_YYYY-MM.csv: Satellite-received feed, same columns, for positions beyond shore range to the edge of the Gulf area covered. Kept in a subfolder: it is a separate product from a separate receiver and is not merged with the shore feed.
files.README.md: Plain-language description of the feed, the reporting intervals and what is absent.
